entities.summary: Karel Bernard Boedijn was a Dutch botanist and mycologist who made significant contributions to the study of tropical fungi in the Dutch East Indies. After earning his doctorate from the University of Amsterdam in 1925, he spent three decades in Southeast Asia as a professor and researcher, surviving Japanese internment during World War II when he identified medicinal plants for fellow prisoners.
